crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The binary is the Windows Local Security Authority process (lsass.exe). This is determined from its embedded manifest, which contains the description 'Local Security Authority Process'. Its behavior is consistent with this role: it marks itself as a critical process using `RtlSetProcessIsCritical`, loads security extensions from the registry (e.g., `System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\LsaExtensionConfig`), communicates with the kernel security driver (`\\Device\\KsecDD`), and sets up RPC and ALPC ports for authentication (e.g., `\\pipe\\lsass`). All observed behaviors are legitimate functions of this core Windows operating system component.
